caption: The first row is the clockwise chain code of the 3×3 ring; the second row is its first difference; the third row is the shape number, the smallest rotation. The raw code starts 0 0, but the normalised shape starts 0 6.

spec.title: 3×3 ring: chain code to shape number
spec.aria: Three rows of eight digits: the chain code 0 0 6 6 4 4 2 2 with its first two digits highlighted, its first difference 6 0 6 0 6 0 6 0, and the shape number 0 6 0 6 0 6 0 6 with its first two digits highlighted.
